lineitem_per_order: SELECT n AS lines_per_order, count(*) AS orders
FROM (SELECT "l_orderkey", count(*) AS n FROM "lineitem" GROUP BY 1)
orders_without_lineitem: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM "orders" o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "lineitem" l WHERE l."l_orderkey" = o."o_orderkey")
customers_without_orders: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM "customer" c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "orders" o WHERE o."o_custkey" = c."c_custkey")
partsupp_per_part: SELECT n AS suppliers_per_part, count(*) AS parts
FROM (SELECT "ps_partkey", count(*) AS n FROM "partsupp" GROUP BY 1)
shipdate_before_orderdate: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM "lineitem" l
WHERE CAST(l."l_shipdate" AS DATE) < CAST(o."o_orderdate" AS DATE)
receiptdate_before_shipdate: WHERE CAST("l_receiptdate" AS DATE) < CAST("l_shipdate" AS DATE)
discount_range: SELECT min(CAST("l_discount" AS DOUBLE)) AS min_discount, max(CAST("l_discount" AS DOUBLE)) AS max_discount
quantity_range: SELECT min(CAST("l_quantity" AS DOUBLE)) AS min_quantity, max(CAST("l_quantity" AS DOUBLE)) AS max_quantity
orderstatus_values: SELECT "o_orderstatus", count(*) AS rows FROM "orders" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
returnflag_linestatus_values: SELECT "l_returnflag", "l_linestatus", count(*) AS rows FROM "lineitem" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
nation_region_distribution: SELECT r."r_name" AS region, count(*) AS nations
FROM "nation" n JOIN "region" r ON r."r_regionkey" = n."n_regionkey"
